HI-2026-GM817.title: Informing the Senate that on August 9, 2026, he has appointed Danielle M. Bass to the Senate, effective immediately, to serve as the Senator from the 18th Senate District to temporarily fill the vacancy created by the resignation of Senator Michelle N. Kidani.

actions.text: Received.

HI-2026-GM817.policyArea: Appointment of Danielle M. Bass as the Senator from the 18th Senate District
HI-2026-GM817.aiSummary: The governor informed the Senate that Danielle M. Bass was appointed to temporarily serve as the senator for Senate District 18, which includes Waipi'o, Crestview, Royal Kunia, part of Mililani, part of Waipahu, and part of Akupu. Her service began at once. The appointment fills the vacancy left by Senator Michelle N. Kidani’s resignation and will end on November 3, 2026.

HI-2026-GM1364.title: Informing the Legislature that on July 15, 2026, the Governor signed the following bill into law: SB2851 SD1 HD2 CD1 (ACT 261).

actions.text: Received.

HI-2026-GM1364.aiSummary: The bill became Act 261 and was signed into law on July 15, 2026. It lets a deaf motor vehicle owner ask for a deafness mark on the vehicle registration, using the international symbol for deafness or a code. That mark would show up when law enforcement checks the vehicle record so officers are alerted that the owner is deaf. The law takes effect on January 1, 2027.

HI-2026-GM1355.aiSummary: Signed into law on July 14, 2026, this act limits when operators of smart household security devices may share user data with law enforcement. Sharing is allowed only with written user consent, a court warrant, or in a narrow emergency, and operators cannot make consent a condition of using the device. It also lets the attorney general take action for violations and treats violations as unfair or deceptive business practices.
